Enemy Appearance |active_in = [[Challenge Trials]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = +10% }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Enemies explode on death|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Exploding Enemies''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Jailed Towers (Modifier)|Jailed Towers]] and before [[Inflation]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match. '''Exploding Enemies''' is part of a group of six modifiers consisting of itself, [[Glass]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], [[Committed]], [[Speedy Enemies]] and [[Flying Enemies]]. These six modifiers cannot have their total reward boost exceed 50%, limiting their boosts to that. This does not prevent modifiers not part of this group from applying their boosts. For example, [[Fog]] will still apply its 20% reward boost when all six are applied, increasing the reward boost from 50% to 70%, though still lower from the expected 95%. ==Effects== When applied, enemies will start exploding on their death in similar fashion as for example the [[Boomer]]. This will stun towers for 1 second and deal 20 damage to units. There is also an additional effect where it adds pirate hats to enemies in similar fashion to the [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]] modifier. ===Enemy Appearance=== ''This does not include every enemy in the game, but only some to show the effects of the modifier.'' LegacyNormalExplodingEnemies.png|Legacy [[Normal]] affected by the '''Exploding Enemies''' modifier. LegacyAbnormalExplodingEnemies.png|Legacy [[Abnormal]] affected by the '''Exploding Enemies''' modifier. LegacyCoolDuckyExplodingEnemies.png|Legacy [[Cool Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Cool Ducky]] affected by the '''Exploding Enemies''' modifier. GooExplodingEnemies.png|[[Goo]] affected by the '''Exploding Enemies''' modifier. LeadBalloonExplodingEnemies.png|[[Lead Balloon]] affected by the '''Exploding Enemies''' modifier. GoldTitanExplodingEnemies.png|[[Gold Titan]] affected by the '''Exploding Enemies''' modifier. ==Update History== *'''24 September 2025''' - [[v1.75.0]] **'''Exploding Enemies''' added. *'''2 July 2026''' - [[v2.1.0|v2.1.7]] **Added a cap for the total reward boost from the [[Glass]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], '''Exploding Enemies''', [[Speedy Enemies]], [[Flying Enemies]] and [[Committed]], limiting their total boosts to 50%, though this is only active in [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Reward boost lowered from +30% to +10%. **Cap for total reward boost from [[Glass]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], '''Exploding Enemies''', [[Speedy Enemies]], [[Flying Enemies]] and [[Committed]] expanded to all gamemodes. {{ModifierNavBox}}
